generic_domain.justification: Attention-based learning is a broad category that encompasses various methods involving attention mechanisms, including both 'attention modeling' and 'structured attention'. 'Attention modeling' refers to the development of models that use attention mechanisms. On the other hand, 'structured attention' focuses on incorporating structure into attention processes, which is a specific aspect within attention-based learning. Therefore, 'attention-based learning' serves as an umbrella term covering these specialized domains.
